publisher: Alabama Secretary of State, Business Services
reassessment_reason: Reconfirm the absence of an established recurring business-entity export in reviewed pages and narrow the public-record fallback by its explicit Alabama-citizen eligibility, while distinguishing UCC pricing and blank filing forms.

access.bulk: Reviewed business pages do not establish a recurring business-entity dataset. Business Downloads contains forms; UCC bulk pricing applies to a different record family.
access.api: No supported public business-entity API or complete export contract was established by the official documentation reviewed.
access.search: Government Records Inquiry provides individual entity name/number and person-role searches. No searches for business records were executed.
access.fees: No business-entity bulk quote established. Public-record policy lists $1/page plus outside costs; UCC fee schedule lists $1,500 full and $300 weekly, not corporate export prices.

fields.summary: Search documentation confirms a six-to-nine digit Entity ID display change through leading zeroes. That is not a current bulk schema or guarantee of universal non-reuse. Blank forms and internal retention descriptions cannot substitute for an export contract.

active_status_semantics: Legal registration/existence does not establish operating activity. Official notice on removal of the SOS annual-report requirement supports caution about using annual filings as current-activity evidence.
statewide_completeness: No exact recurring product population, row totals, byte size or complete source snapshot was established; absence from the reviewed docs is not proof that no export can exist.
address_zip: No current bulk principal-address/ZIP domain was established. Registered-agent and service addresses must remain separate from operating sites. Future ZIP5 and ZIP4 fields stay separate and identifiers retain leading zeroes.
automation_terms_fees: The official public-record request route is described for Alabama citizens; project eligibility is unverified. Free online inspection is described for the general public, but does not establish a bulk automation contract.
redistribution: The public-record policy provides inspection/copy procedures, not a product-specific commercial transformation, geocoding or redistribution specification. Applicable source terms remain unresolved.
temporal_refresh: No snapshot/delta schedule, deletion or correction semantics, replay, checksums or current delivery controls were established. Historic annual-report forms do not prove a continuing refresh requirement.

citations.evidence: Individual search options and official six-to-nine digit Entity ID display notice.
Downloads page lists blank filing forms rather than a business-entity dataset.
Alabama-citizen request route, separate free online access for the public and quoted-copy process.
Bulk fee line belongs specifically to UCC, not business entities.
Official announcement describes removal of SOS annual-report requirement.

strongest_next_action: Keep HOLD and prepare a product-existence/contract question set. Establish an eligible route before proposing a public-record request; do not assume Alabama citizenship. Require exact business-entity scope, schema, identity/status/address contracts, refresh/replay controls and rights before connector implementation. No public-record submission, source contact, record request, scraping, payment or production action is authorized.
